source_text:
15. Declaration with regard to dimensions and weight to be made on packages in
certain cases.-
Where the dimensions and weight, or combination thereof, of a commodity has or have a
relationship to the price of that commodity, the declaration of quantity on the package
containing such commodity, shall also include a declaration as to such dimensions,
weight or combination.
